arguments.value: This is a Chase Bank USA, N.A. affiliate agreement with the affiliate program participant. It lets the affiliate place Chase links on its website and earn referral fees for approved Chase credit card accounts that come through those links. Chase can accept or reject affiliates, change the commission terms, and end the agreement at any time. The affiliate must follow Chase’s rules on acceptable website content, keywords, privacy policy, trademarks, and marketing methods, and must not use restricted or offensive content or prohibited trademark terms. Chase handles the credit card applications and account processing, while the affiliate is responsible for keeping links working and may have to indemnify Chase for claims arising from the affiliate’s site or breaches of the agreement. The term starts when Chase approves the registration form and continues until either party terminates it; Chase may also terminate for noncompliance. The agreement is governed by Delaware law.
